--- select_tvf_tablesample.sql
SELECT * FROM f() TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10 PERCENT)

--- AST
&ast.QueryStatement{
  Query: &ast.Select{
    Results: []ast.SelectItem{
      &ast.Star{
        Star: 7,
      },
    },
    From: &ast.From{
      From:   9,
      Source: &ast.TVFCallExpr{
        Rparen: 16,
        Name:   &ast.Path{
          Idents: []*ast.Ident{
            &ast.Ident{
              NamePos: 14,
              NameEnd: 15,
              Name:    "f",
            },
          },
        },
        Sample: &ast.TableSample{
          TableSample: 18,
          Method:      "BERNOULLI",
          Size:        &ast.TableSampleSize{
            Lparen: 40,
            Rparen: 51,
            Value:  &ast.IntLiteral{
              ValuePos: 41,
              ValueEnd: 43,
              Base:     10,
              Value:    "10",
            },
            Unit: "PERCENT",
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
SELECT * FROM f() TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10 PERCENT)
